title: Catastrophic-Cap Reprocessing of TRICARE Select Outpatient Lines
content:
A **TRICARE Select** outpatient line found to have been cost-shared after the family had already reached its catastrophic cap is reversed for catastrophic-cap reprocessing and adjudicated again; on a beneficiary's request about such a line, its reprocessed adjudication is posted as a new paid line of the same claim. The TRICARE payment on that reprocessed line is settled by the TRICARE Select rules for lines reprocessed for the catastrophic cap.

## The line concerned

The line reprocessed is the line with no inpatient days named by the enrollment's most recent catastrophic-cap reversal, and its service date, network relationship, service class, billed and allowed amounts and the other insurer's payment are read from that reversed line.

For a line reprocessed for the catastrophic cap under these rules, and only for such a line, the authorization finding of the line it replaces stands in place of a fresh authorization test: the reprocessed line is payable on that finding and carries that line's authorization reference, because only the family's catastrophic standing is revisited; every other Select line remains under the base authorization rule.

## Condition on the payment

The TRICARE payment on a line reprocessed for the catastrophic cap is fixed only after every inpatient stay of the plan year that stands reversed for other health insurance carries its reprocessed adjudication.

Equivalently: as long as the claim records show an inpatient stay of the plan year reversed for other health insurance with no reprocessed adjudication, the payment on the cap-reprocessed line is not yet fixed.

## Posting

The agent posts the reprocessed adjudication for the verified beneficiary: one new paid line is added to the same claim, repeating the reversed line's claim number, patient, service date, rendering provider, network relationship, service class, receipt date, billed, allowed and other-insurance amounts, and carrying the beneficiary liability and the TRICARE payment given, with no deductible. The reprocessed line then shows on the Explanation of Benefits as paid.

The tool is `post_select_cap_reprocessed_line_5ecdf694`, an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `reversed_claim_line_id` | the reference number of the adjudicated line that the catastrophic-cap reversal withdrew, read from the reversal entry's reversed-line field in the claim-line lookup for the enrollment | identifier |
| `line_number` | the line number the reprocessed adjudication takes on the same claim | integer, 1 or more, no decimal point |
| `cost_share_amount` | the beneficiary liability on the reprocessed line | US dollars, 2 decimal places (rounded half up to the cent), 0.00 when none |
| `tricare_paid_amount` | the amount TRICARE pays on the reprocessed line | US dollars, 2 decimal places (rounded half up to the cent) |

## Return

On success: a confirmation sentence beginning "Cap-reprocessed line posted", naming the new claim-line reference number (beginning "scl"), the claim number and line number posted, the line outcome "paid", and the beneficiary liability and TRICARE payment posted in US dollars with 2 decimals. No other outcome is defined.
